completion.summary: New packages/ui/src/prefs.ts: readPrefs, writePrefs(patch) and usePrefs() (useSyncExternalStore) over localStorage["sati.ui.v1"]. Every storage access is in try/catch; bad JSON, wrong types and unknown keys give defaults or are dropped. Hand-written validation (the UI has no zod). Fields: collapsedColumns, theme. Not wired into the board yet (WP1 and WP15 do that); no visible change, so no changeset and test:ui not run.
